fusions.name: Torpor Haze
fusions.desc: Breathes a cone of numbing reef venom that deals 26 damage to everything caught in it and ignores resistances. Each target is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Sheds a hardened lump of reef at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Still
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You also restore 6 health.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Crust
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 15%. Your dodge chance rises by 4% at all times.
